description.value: So Hyang Korean Cuisine is a Korean restaurant on Fraser Street in Vancouver's Sunset neighbourhood, open seven days a week. The restaurant operates on a walk-in basis with no reservations accepted, and offers online order-ahead for pickup. It sits on a busy arterial cycling corridor connecting south Vancouver to the city centre.
